verdict.rationale: E2B is sandbox infrastructure, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The connect-LLMs doc describes using the LLM's own tool-use capabilities, and the coding-agent docs describe running agents inside sandboxes; neither is an official MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
